48: @Service
49: public class ICalService {
50: 
51:     private static final Logger LOG = getLogger(lookup().lookupClass());
52: 
53:     private final CalendarProperties calendarProperties;
54: 
55:     private final DateTimeFormatter formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd");
56: 
57:     @Autowired
58:     ICalService(CalendarProperties calendarProperties) {
59:         this.calendarProperties = calendarProperties;
60:     }
61: 
62:     public ByteArrayResource getCalendar(String title, List<Absence> absences, Person recipient) {
63:         final Calendar calendar = generateCalendar(title, absences, recipient);
64:         return writeCalenderIntoRessource(calendar);
65:     }
66: 
67:     public ByteArrayResource getSingleAppointment(Absence absence, ICalType method, Person recipient) {
68:         final Calendar calendar = generateForSingleAppointment(absence, method, recipient);
69:         return writeCalenderIntoRessource(calendar);
70:     }
71: 
72:     private Calendar generateCalendar(String title, List<Absence> absences, Person recipient) {
73:         final Calendar calendar = prepareCalendar(absences, PUBLISHED, recipient);
74:         calendar.getProperties().add(new XProperty("X-WR-CALNAME", title));
75:         calendar.getProperties().add(new RefreshInterval(new ParameterList(), calendarProperties.getRefreshInterval()));
76:         return calendar;
77:     }
78: 
79:     private Calendar generateForSingleAppointment(Absence absence, ICalType method, Person recipient) {
80:         return prepareCalendar(List.of(absence), method, recipient);
81:     }
82: 
83:     private Calendar prepareCalendar(List<Absence> absences, ICalType method, Person recipient) {
84:         final Calendar calendar = new Calendar();
85:         calendar.getProperties().add(VERSION_2_0);
86:         calendar.getProperties().add(new ProdId("-//Urlaubsverwaltung//iCal4j 1.0//DE"));
87:         calendar.getProperties().add(GREGORIAN);
88:         calendar.getProperties().add(new XProperty("X-MICROSOFT-CALSCALE", GREGORIAN.getValue()));
89: 
90:         if (method == CANCELLED) {
91:             calendar.getProperties().add(CANCEL);
92:         }
93: 
94:         absences.stream()
95:             .map(absence -> this.toVEvent(absence, method, absence.getPerson().equals(recipient)))
96:             .filter(Optional::isPresent)
97:             .map(Optional::get)
98:             .forEach(event -> calendar.getComponents().add(event));
99: 
100:         return calendar;
101:     }
102: 
103:     private Optional<VEvent> toVEvent(Absence absence, ICalType method, boolean isOwn) {
104: 
105:         final ZonedDateTime startDateTime = absence.getStartDate();
106:         final ZonedDateTime endDateTime = absence.getEndDate();
107: 
108:         final VEvent event;
109:         if (absence.isAllDay()) {
110:             try {
111:                 final Date startDate = new Date(startDateTime.format(formatter));
112:                 if (isSameDay(startDateTime, endDateTime)) {
113:                     event = new VEvent(startDate, absence.getEventSubject());
114:                 } else {
115:                     final Date endDate = new Date(endDateTime.format(formatter));
116:                     event = new VEvent(new Date(startDate), new Date(endDate), absence.getEventSubject());
117:                 }
118:             } catch (ParseException e) {
119:                 LOG.warn("Could not generate all day ical event for absence {}", absence, e);
120:                 return Optional.empty();
121:             }
122: 
123:             event.getProperties().add(new XProperty("X-MICROSOFT-CDO-ALLDAYEVENT", "TRUE"));
124:         } else {
125:             final DateTime start = new DateTime(from(startDateTime.toInstant()));
126:             start.setUtc(true);
127:             final DateTime end = new DateTime(from(endDateTime.toInstant()));
128:             end.setUtc(true);
129: 
130:             event = new VEvent(start, end, absence.getEventSubject());
131:         }
132: 
133:         event.getProperties().add(new Uid(generateUid(absence)));
134:         if (absence.getPerson().getEmail() != null) {
135:             event.getProperties().add(generateAttendee(absence));
136:         }
137: 
138:         if (absence.isHolidayReplacement() || !isOwn) {
139:             event.getProperties().add(new Transp(VALUE_TRANSPARENT));
140:         }
141: 
142:         if (method == CANCELLED) {
143:             event.getProperties().add(new Sequence(1));
144:         }
145: 
146:         event.getProperties().add(new Organizer(URI.create("mailto:" + calendarProperties.getOrganizer())));
147: 
148:         return Optional.of(event);
149:     }
150: 
151:     private Attendee generateAttendee(Absence absence) {
152:         final Attendee attendee = new Attendee(URI.create("mailto:" + absence.getPerson().getEmail()));
153:         attendee.getParameters().add(REQ_PARTICIPANT);
154:         attendee.getParameters().add(new Cn(absence.getPerson().getNiceName()));
155: 
156:         return attendee;
157:     }
158: 
159:     private boolean isSameDay(ZonedDateTime startDateTime, ZonedDateTime endDate) {
160:         return startDateTime.toLocalDate().isEqual(endDate.toLocalDate().minusDays(1));
161:     }
162: 
163:     private String generateUid(Absence absence) {
164:         final String data = absence.getStartDate() + "" + absence.getEndDate() + absence.getPerson();
165:         return DigestUtils.md5Hex(data).toUpperCase();
166:     }
167: 
168:     private ByteArrayResource writeCalenderIntoRessource(Calendar calendar) {
169: 
170:         final boolean validation = !calendar.getComponents().isEmpty();
171: 
172:         final ByteArrayResource byteArrayResource;
173:         try (final ByteArrayOutputStream byteArrayOutputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
174:             final CalendarOutputter calendarOutputter = new CalendarOutputter(validation);
175:             calendarOutputter.output(calendar, byteArrayOutputStream);
176:             byteArrayResource = new ByteArrayResource(byteArrayOutputStream.toByteArray());
177:         } catch (ValidationException | IOException e) {
178:             throw new CalendarException("iCal calendar could not be written to ByteArrayResource", e);
179:         }
180:         return byteArrayResource;
181:     }
182: }
